description: Free, keyless MCP server with 50 read-only blockchain tools for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Mezo. No installation, no API key required - just add the URL to your MCP client and start querying balances, transactions, blocks, ENS names, ERC-20 tokens, smart contracts, and more. Runs on Cloudflare's global edge network via Streamable HTTP. All tools are strictly read-only and stateless.
